title: Serre's Conjecture II on Galois Cohomology of Simply Connected Semisimple Groups
exact_target: Over a perfect field of cohomological dimension at most two, must every torsor under a semisimple simply connected algebraic group have a rational point?

sources.citation: Philippe Gille, "Serre's conjecture II: a survey," in Quadratic forms, linear algebraic groups, and cohomology, Dev. Math. 18, Springer, New York (2010), 41-56.
